description: This file is a shell script used for testing rename detection functionality in a diff engine, specifically in the context of Git. It defines test cases, setups, and validation steps for different scenarios involving file renaming and diff comparison.

methods.name: compare_diff_patch
methods.description: Compares the actual diff output to the expected patch.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in the output to verify expected text appears.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Helper function to create files with specific content lines.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files for content equality.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal clock used in tests, ensuring unique timestamps.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of all tests.
